name: Yarmouth
text: Yarmouth is a port town in southwestern Nova Scotia, Canada at the entrance to the Gulf of Maine—making it a significant coastal town for maritime activity. Yarmouth is the shire town of Yarmouth County and is the largest population centre in the region.

depictions.name: Yarmouth
depictions.text: Yarmouth, Nova Scotia Yarmouth is a town and port located on the Gulf of Maine in southwestern Nova Scotia, Canada. During the mid-18th century, it was a largely uninhabited region, trademarked by rocky shores and dense forests, which were populated by beavers. Yarmouth was at some point visited by the Assassin-turned-Templar Shay Cormac, who explored the area and provided money to renovate a local hunting lodge.
